advancements.frieren.aura_obeyed.title: Aura, Kill Yourself
advancements.frieren.first_spell.descrip: Learn your first spell from a grimoire
advancements.frieren.first_spell.title: Basic Magic
advancements.frieren.learned_demon.descr: Learn a spell of demon magic
advancements.frieren.learned_demon.title: Know Your Enemy
advancements.frieren.rank_first_class.de: Pass Serie's interview and become a First-Class Mage
advancements.frieren.root.description: Receive a Journey Journal and begin your life as a mage
advancements.frieren.root.title: Beyond Journey's End
advancements.frieren.slay_demon.title: They Speak, But Do Not Understand
aura.frieren.phase.scales: Aura takes up the Scales of Obedience!
boss.frieren.aura.enthrall: Aura's scales tipped against %s. Their body is no longer their own.
boss.frieren.aura.obey: The scales tip toward %s. Aura is commanded to kill herself!
boss.frieren.aura.weighing: Aura raises the Scales of Obedience toward %s. Release your concealment now!
boss.frieren.spiegel.exposed: The last replica breaks. Spiegel is exposed!
boss.frieren.spiegel.immune: Spiegel cannot be harmed while its reflections remain.
boss.frieren.spiegel.reflect: Spiegel copies a reflection of you.
commands.frieren.exam.passed: %s passed the exam and is now a %s
commands.frieren.no_data: That player has no magic data.
death.attack.frieren.curse.player: %1$s succumbed to a curse while fighting %2$s
death.attack.frieren.demon_magic.player: %1$s fell to demon magic while fighting %2$s
death.attack.frieren.spell.player: %1$s was blasted apart by magic while fighting %2$s
death.attack.frieren.zoltraak.item: %1$s was pierced by %2$s's Zoltraak cast through %3$s
death.attack.frieren.zoltraak.player: %1$s was pierced by Zoltraak while fighting %2$s
demon.frieren.plea.0: Please, I don't want to die...
demon.frieren.plea.1: Mother... I only wanted to see my mother.
demon.frieren.plea.2: Let's talk. Surely we can understand each other.
demon.frieren.plea.3: I surrender. I'll never harm a human again.
exam.frieren.already_active: You are already taking an exam.
exam.frieren.max_rank: You hold the highest rank already.
exam.frieren.not_eligible: You are not yet eligible for the %s exam:
exam.frieren.nothing_to_submit: You have nothing the examiner is waiting for.
exam.frieren.privilege: Serie's privilege: choose one Legendary spell.
exam.frieren.privilege_none: You have no privilege to claim.
exam.frieren.serie_fail: "No." Serie turns away. Train and come back.
exam.frieren.serie_pass: "Fine. You pass." Serie seems almost amused.
exam.frieren.started: Your %s exam has begun. Use the Exam Seal to check your objective.
exam.stage.frieren.interview.desc: Speak with Serie. She will look straight through your concealment.
exam.stage.frieren.labyrinth.desc: Reach the heart of a dungeon and face the reflection waiting there.
exam.stage.frieren.practical.desc: Defeat hostile creatures using only magic.
exam.stage.frieren.retrieval.desc: Find the sealed grimoire hidden in a Forgotten Library and bring it to an examiner.
exam.stage.frieren.stille.desc: Capture a Stille in a Stille Cage and hand it over. Brute force will not work.
exam.stage.frieren.survival.desc: Stay alive until time runs out and defeat demons along the way.
message.frieren.altar_hint: The altar waits for a sigil.
message.frieren.deceived: %s was never going to let you live.
message.frieren.desk_copy_cost: Transcription needs a book, %s mana crystals and a spell you know.
message.frieren.desk_cost: Analysis needs %s mana crystals and %s mana.
message.frieren.desk_help: Hold a sealed demon grimoire to analyse it, or a known grimoire and a book to transcribe it.
message.frieren.desk_rank: Only a %s or higher can analyse demon magic.
message.frieren.desk_unknown_spell: You can only transcribe a spell you already know.
message.frieren.empty_slot: No spell in this slot. Open the spellbook to assign one.
message.frieren.enthralled: Your body moves on its own...
message.frieren.flight_disabled: Flight is disabled on this server.
message.frieren.flight_exhausted: Out of mana. You drift down.
message.frieren.grimoire_sealed: It is sealed. Analyse it at a Spell Research Desk.
message.frieren.mana_capped: Your mana will not grow further at this rank.
message.frieren.missing_definition: Unknown spell %s. The data pack that added it is missing.
message.frieren.no_health: You are too hurt to pay this spell's price.
message.frieren.seal_idle: No exam in progress. Talk to an Association Examiner.
message.frieren.seal_objective: Objective offset: X %s, Z %s (%s blocks away)
message.frieren.seek_death: Your last death lies %s, %s blocks away.
message.frieren.seek_nothing: Your seeking magic finds nothing of interest.
message.frieren.sense_through: You sense %s signature(s), and one of them is hiding its true mana.
message.frieren.stille_not_yours: That cage belongs to someone else's exam.
message.frieren.stille_too_fast: It is still too lively. Tire it out first.
message.frieren.summoned.aura: Aura the Guillotine answers the summons.
message.frieren.summoned.qual: Qual the Corruptor emerges from his seal.
message.frieren.summoned.spiegel: The mirror shatters, and Spiegel steps out.
message.frieren.unknown_spell: You do not know that spell.
npc.frieren.examiner.line.0: The Association tests every mage the same way.
npc.frieren.examiner.line.1: Your rank is earned, not bought.
npc.frieren.examiner.line.2: Speak to me when you are ready for your exam.
npc.frieren.fern.line.1: Basic attack magic is enough if you're fast.
npc.frieren.frieren.line.0: I'm collecting spells. Got any grimoires?
npc.frieren.frieren.line.1: Ten years is not very long, you know.
npc.frieren.frieren.line.2: Flowers are nice. That's the whole reason.
npc.frieren.frieren.line.3: I'll check that chest. It is definitely not a mimic.
npc.frieren.priest.heal: The Goddess's light washes over you.
npc.frieren.priest.line.0: May the Goddess watch over your journey.
npc.frieren.priest.line.1: Rest a moment. I can mend that.
npc.frieren.priest.line.2: Holy water? No, this is just water.
npc.frieren.serie.interview: Serie studies you for a long time. Then she makes up her mind.
npc.frieren.serie.line.0: Your mana is as plain as your face.
npc.frieren.serie.line.2: Magic is only what you imagine it to be.
npc.frieren.stark.line.0: I'm not scared. My hands are just cold.
npc.frieren.stark.line.1: Leave the front line to me.
npc.frieren.wandering_mage.line.0: I trade grimoires for mana crystals.
npc.frieren.wandering_mage.line.1: The roads are full of demons lately.
npc.frieren.wandering_mage.line.2: Someone always buys Flower Field. Always.
quest.frieren.aura_kill_yourself.reward: Reward: +60 mana growth and an unidentified Legendary grimoire
quest.frieren.journey_begins.desc: Learn your first spell from a grimoire.
quest.frieren.mimic_hunter.desc: Research mimics: find 3 of them, the hard way if necessary.
screen.frieren.journey.eligible: You are eligible for the next exam.
screen.frieren.spellbook.hint: Click a spell, then a slot to assign it. Right-click a slot to clear it.
screen.frieren.spellbook.none: You know no spells. Read a grimoire.
spell.frieren.azeryuze.desc: Demon magic. Weighs your mana against a creature's; if yours is far greater, it obeys you for a while.
spell.frieren.barrier_dome.desc: Raises a protective dome that shields allies inside from hostile magic.
spell.frieren.catastravia.desc: Fills the sky with shafts of light that rain down on an area for several seconds.
spell.frieren.clothes_cleaning.desc: Mends the durability of your worn equipment. A housekeeping spell with surprising value.
spell.frieren.curse_purification.desc: Cleanses curses, enthrallment and harmful effects from you and nearby allies.
spell.frieren.defensive_magic.desc: Toggle a personal barrier. Absorbs spell damage efficiently and blocks melee partially, draining mana while up.
spell.frieren.diagolze.desc: Forbidden. Curses a target into gold. Bosses resist; everyone else becomes a statue for a while.
spell.frieren.flight_magic.desc: Toggle flight. Drains mana every second; you will float down safely when it runs out.
spell.frieren.flower_field.desc: Makes a field of flowers bloom around you. Useless in combat. Absolutely essential.
spell.frieren.gathering_magic.desc: Pulls nearby dropped items and experience toward you.
spell.frieren.goddess_healing.desc: Priestly magic that heals the ally you look at, or yourself.
spell.frieren.judradjim.desc: Calls a lightning strike onto the point you are looking at, shocking all nearby.
spell.frieren.lands_doppelganger.desc: Leaves a mana decoy behind that draws enemy attention while you slip away.
spell.frieren.light_orb.desc: Conjures a floating light where you look. It fades after a few minutes.
spell.frieren.mimic_detection.desc: Reveals nearby mimics disguised as chests. Has a small chance of being wrong.
spell.frieren.qual_zoltraak.desc: The original demon version: a heavier beam that tears through barriers and pierces a target.
spell.frieren.reelseiden.desc: A close-range slashing spell that cleaves through barriers in a wide arc.
spell.frieren.rust_removal.desc: Strips oxidation from copper blocks in front of you. Statues everywhere thank you.
spell.frieren.seeking_magic.desc: Points toward the nearest point of interest: your last death, or else a ruin worth exploring.
spell.frieren.vollzanbel.desc: Breathes a cone of hellfire that sets everything in front of you ablaze.
spell.frieren.waldgose.desc: Summons a cutting whirlwind at a distance that drags in and shreds enemies.
spell.frieren.zoltraak.desc: Fires a piercing beam of killing magic. Once a demon's spell; now the most studied spell on the continent.
spell.frieren.zoltraak_barrage.desc: Hold to loose a stream of Zoltraak bolts. Each pulse costs mana while the key is held.
tooltip.frieren.artifact_hint: Works while in your hotbar or offhand.
tooltip.frieren.concealment_charm.effect: Concealment hides 15% more mana and trains twice as fast
tooltip.frieren.demon_horn: Still warm. Demons are never as harmless as they sound.
tooltip.frieren.demonic_mana_core: The condensed mana of a slain demon.
tooltip.frieren.exam_seal: Use to see your current exam objective.
tooltip.frieren.grimoire_sealed: Sealed. Analyse it at a Spell Research Desk.
tooltip.frieren.grimoire_unidentified: Unidentified. Read it to discover its spell.
tooltip.frieren.guillotine_blade: Aura's weapon. The scales are gone, but the edge remains.
tooltip.frieren.heiter_flask: Never empties itself, and never quite sobers you up.
tooltip.frieren.journey_journal: Use to open your journey: rank, mana and quests.
tooltip.frieren.mage_attire: Mage's Attire: each piece adds max mana and regeneration.
tooltip.frieren.mana_crystal: Crystallised mana. Fuel for research and transcription.
tooltip.frieren.mirror_lotus_ring: A ring said to mean eternal love. Polished, not appraised.
tooltip.frieren.sealed_exam_grimoire: The exam objective. Return it to an examiner unopened.
tooltip.frieren.sigil_spiegel: Summons Spiegel, the mirror of the labyrinth.
tooltip.frieren.staff_apprentice: A spellcasting focus. Hold it in either hand while casting.
tooltip.frieren.staff_guillotine: A spellcasting focus. Hold it in either hand while casting.
tooltip.frieren.staff_mage: A spellcasting focus. Hold it in either hand while casting.
tooltip.frieren.staff_sage: A spellcasting focus. Hold it in either hand while casting.
tooltip.frieren.stille_cage: Empty. Use on an exhausted Stille.
